name: Export diagnostics
summary: Help, Export Diagnostics... saves a redacted diagnostics zip wherever you choose; crash dumps and crash lines stay on your computer and nothing is sent anywhere.
where: Help menu in the menu bar, Export Diagnostics...
The Carnivore icon menu in the menu bar, Export Diagnostics..., also while the server is down.
how_to: Pick Help, Export Diagnostics... and choose where the zip is saved.
Attach the zip yourself when you ask for help; Carnivore never uploads it.
Expect secrets to be starred out of the logs inside the zip.
examples: Save the zip to the Desktop after a crash and send it to a teammate by hand.
media_exempt: native: a macOS save dialog and a zip written to disk, which no browser capture can show
